adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a transaction ordering issue in addGuests.handler.ts. Looking at the diff: lines 92-108 show `prisma.booking.update()` creating new attendee records in the database, then line 163 calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)`. If the calendar update fails, the database already has the new attendees persisted. On retry, lines 74-78 filter out guests that already exist in `booking.attendees`, and if all guests were already added to DB, `uniqueGuests.length === 0` triggers the BAD_REQUEST error at line 80. This is a real split-brain scenario where database and calendar provider can become inconsistent with no clean recovery path.
